title: One Doppler account on all your Apple devices
metaTitle: Use One VPN Account on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch
metaDescription: Doppler's account is an anonymous ID, not an email. How to add your iPhone, iPad and Mac to the same plan, manage the Devices screen, and where Apple Watch fits.
excerpt: Your account is an ID, not an email. Add your iPad, Mac and Apple Watch to the same plan in a minute.

faq.question: How many devices can use one Doppler plan?
faq.answer: Up to 10. The Devices screen shows how many slots are in use, and you can remove a device you no longer use to free one.

faq.question: Does Apple Watch count as a device?
faq.answer: No. The watch app is a remote for the VPN on your iPhone and has no tunnel or account of its own.

faq.question: What if I lose my account ID?
faq.answer: If you bought through the App Store, Restore Purchases on a device signed in to the same Apple ID brings your plan back. Otherwise keep the ID safe: Doppler never had your name or email, so it cannot look the account up for you.

faq.question: Does the same account work on Android and Windows?
faq.answer: Yes. Enter the same account ID in Doppler for Android or Windows. A plan bought through the App Store is still managed in your Apple ID settings.
